char_getCharacter_10000004: I am Jumakenki Katas!! Harbinger of eternal doom brought by the abyssal corrupt —... Good, that was good.
char_resume_des_10000004_0_des: The mysterious girl Katas from the Empire of Abyss, carrying (an axe no matter how you look at it) the magic sword Umbral Fulgor. Locked in battle against the endless forces of dawn. The journey ahead will lead to the ultimate battle to destroy the old world! — If Katas were the main character of an adventure comic, the above would most likely be its synopsis, though it's all because of her insistent request. Each of her appearances is like a comic character coming to life, though reality can't craft a ring of focus lines around her to emphasize the effect... Nay, given her adventure spirit, she'd find a way to make even more impactful entrance in no time.
char_getCharacter_10000025: Julian. Good at attacking, not defending. Leave the attack to me.
char_resume_des_10000025_0_des: B.C.R.L. Team Ratel's vice-captain, responsible for part of the command and negotiation duties. Has a very calm demeanor, assumes the role of pouring cold water on others during negotiations and combat. Appears to be the most reliable person in Team Ratel, at least on the surface. During missions, she's the first to assess the overall situation, making her a good deputy to Captain Shizuru, and tempers the two crew members' enthusiasm and affection. Skilful, fast runner, and probably a hard hitter, but seems to prefer guns.
char_getCharacter_10000054: I'm Margiela. I'm the manager of a cosplay costume shop. Nice to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000054_0_des: Margiela runs a boutique cosplay store. Although it is a small operation, it provides thoughtful service with attention to detail and  custom products that earned it a good reputation and loyal customer base. As a Night Chains member, she would close the shop if she's needed for a mission. Margiela's true passion lies in cosplay, particularly dressing up as a little witch from an anime.
char_getCharacter_10000055: We've already been through so much together, but the road ahead is still long... Let's go. I'll be by your side, Conductor.
char_resume_des_10000055_0_des: Conductor's assistant. Livia suffered critical injuries in an accident many years ago and was rescued by Signora Medici, head of COLUMBA. Upon regaining consciousness, Livia had lost most of her memories, other than the Mundus Empire being her birth place. To repay Signora Medici, Livia joined COLUMBA after passing the crew exam and, by pure chance, teamed up once again with her training school classmate — the Conductor.
char_getCharacter_10000059: Former Mundus Empire's soldier, Connor. Working as a bodyguard now for some reason. Pleased to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000059_0_des: Connor is Livia's old acquaintance. According to both her and Livia, she was once an Empire soldier. She stands out among mercenaries with her outstanding skills and valiant bearing, and has earned a good reputation. Her chivalric demeanor makes it easy for people to trust her, and many Imperials with mercenary experience on the surface have been under her care. After encountering many experiences, Connor has had one thing in mind. How should she change for the happiness of those important to her?
char_getCharacter_10000060: I'm Tara, and this is Cook.
char_resume_des_10000060_0_des: After experiencing a series of unexpected events with the adventure team, the girl decided to join them. She travels with a large eagle-like bird named Cook. With simple attire and a petite frame, she appears relaxed and carefree. Hailing from the Mundus Empire, she seems to have no bias against the surface world and is interested in sceneries. She's a tiny traveler in search of someone. Her current goal in life is to find her father, who left home for years, and give him a good beating.
char_getCharacter_10000062: I'm Solum. Due to some reasons, I can only move through my sister's body now. Nice to meet you!
char_resume_des_10000062_0_des: People often use the word "disharmony" to describe Solum because "she" is strange in many ways: While Solum has a feminine body and a young girl's voice, her mannerisms and tone are unlike that of a "young girl". If you underestimate this guard because of her petite stature, you would suffer — Hmm, perhaps it's a disguise to confuse enemies?
char_getCharacter_10000063: I'm Maruha. I'll chase away all the bad guys.
char_resume_des_10000063_0_des: As a waitress at the Night Chains Hotel, Maruha's friendly smile leaves a deep impression on everyone. Although she makes occasional clumsy mistakes, her friendly attitude allows her to maintain good relationships with colleagues and guests. However, if she were just a friendly and gentle waitress, how could Maruha establish herself in an organization like Night Chains? There seems to be something hidden behind that smile...
char_getCharacter_10000064: I'm Cecil, a Scent Researcher... I don't dislike your scent. Nice to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000064_0_des: Calm and firm researcher, Cecil has a innately acute sense of smell and a great interest in studying scents since young. After joining Night Chains, her research has achieved considerable success. While it isn't tough approaching Cecil, you'll definitely face her disdain if you've come into contact with something pungent. Long-time Night Chains members also agree: when Cecil shows particular interest and closeness to someone, that person should be on guard.
char_getCharacter_10000065: I'm Reika. I prefer to be alone off-work. Don't ever talk to me!
char_resume_des_10000065_0_des: B.C.R.L Team Meerkat's Demolitions expert, a sharp-tongued loner. While Reika's skills and precision in demolitions score full marks, her interpersonal skills and teamwork are unfortunately in the negatives. Even if you've known her for a long time, you might suddenly wonder if she ever intended to get along with you. Since none of her current teammates is overly outgoing, Reika is quite satisfied with the status quo.
char_getCharacter_10000068: I'm Desiree! My dream is to be a pure and lovely girl who can smile wherever I go! Nice to meet you!
char_resume_des_10000068_0_des: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA. Desiree is spirited and always brings joy with her innocent remarks. However, once she enters combat, her ruthless and precise archery instills fear. Her marksmanship can almost be described as unfailingly accurate. The stark contrast between her youthful appearance and her proficient use of ascension abilities, which are nearly on par with B.C.R.L veterans with at least five years, hints at an extraordinary past.
char_getCharacter_10000069: Hello, I'm Charlotte, currently managing the "Knight's Hall" on the surface. Nice to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000069_0_des: Charlotte, who Single-handedly founded the Knight's Hall, not only comes from a noble family but was also a soldier. As a result, she has impeccable swordsmanship, aesthetics, and etiquette. Charlotte is known for her gentle and courteous demeanor, as well as her eager and responsible attitude. Everyone knows that if they need help, they can count on her. In addition to accepting security assignments, the Knight's Hall also offers swordsmanship training. Due to the professional security and reasonable prices, it is popular among the commoners.
char_getCharacter_10000071: I am Aoba. I only follow Yoizuki's orders.
char_resume_des_10000071_0_des: Night Chains security crew member, she isn't armed and doesn't usually ride the train alone. Aoba is quiet and doesn't interact much with others on the train. Her sole duty is to protect her younger sister, Yoizuki, the future head of Mugenryu. A more Night Chains-style codename for Aoba would be "Shadow Dancer of Yoizuki". She obeys her sister's orders without question. Standing alone in the shadows, Aoba is like a shade unwilling to exist.
char_getCharacter_10000134: I am Eliot, I will do the work that needs to be done.
char_resume_des_10000134_0_des: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA, currently stationed on The Eternal, and has a good relationship with Fran. Although she usually seems lazy, her observation and sensitivity are exceptionally keen, always sensing danger early. She's an excellent hunter, so you'd better be careful if targeted by her crossbow. At critical moments, Eliot becomes serious and is an indispensable help.
char_identity_10000145: Honorary Herald of Source Citadel: Destroyer
char_getCharacter_10000145: I am Lissandra. Whether it's brilliance or darkness, as long as your faith is steadfast, I will eventually reach your side.
char_resume_des_10000145_0_des: An honorary herald working in the Destroyer at Source Citadel, Lissandra is a mentor and predecessor to many members within the Destroyer and other organizations, with her age undisclosed. Sporting a perennially dependable smile, she holds strong beliefs and excels in philosophical contemplation and debate. Notably, she is renowned for engaging in a three-day discourse with a peer mentor of equivalent standing. While she is a trustworthy ally in times of peril, it is advised to steer clear of deep philosophical discussions on topics like humanity, society, and life with Lissandra, as those who have attempted this have learned their lessons the hard way.
char_identity_10000153: Night Chains - Night Chains Lesage Overseer
char_getCharacter_10000153: I am Yoizuki of Night Chains. I look forward to working with you in the future.
char_resume_des_10000153_0_des: Yoizuki is the next head of the Dream Profound Style, and is also the overall person-in-charge of Night Chains Lesage. Her mere presence is as beautiful as a blooming night cherry tree, causing other passengers on The Eternal to mistake that they boarded the wrong train. She is kind and skilled in communication and negotiation, showing no airs of a family head, always wearing a gentle, proper smile on her face. Whether the train is attacked or receives sudden unknown communications, she handles it all with unmoving grace with no hint of fear. Additionally, the crew's manifest lists a bodyguard, who occasionally appears beside her like a shadow.
char_resume_des_10000154_0_des: Sniper from B.C.R.L Team Meerkat, well-known recluse whose motto is to never stepping outside unless absolutely necessary. Ilona frequently misses lively group events and often disappears during missions, with team members saying she hides in a concealed spot. Fortunately, her shooting skills are excellent, and she has various means of providing support to ensure she isn't forgotten. When B.C.R.L. members and other train passengers mention her, they always ask, "Did she go out today?"
char_getCharacter_10000156: I'm Shizuru. Nice to meet you... No way, I didn't expect to meet you again at such a place.
char_resume_des_10000156_0_des: Young but capable captain of BCRL Team Ratel. Although her overall abilities are not as good as other Team Ratel members, her quick reflexes, grasp of command, and tactical planning make her a convincing leader. The Conductor's friend for many years, although their communication has mostly been limited to long-distance.
char_getCharacter_10000157: My name is Arcana. Just a traveler you find anywhere.
char_resume_des_10000157_0_des: Leader of the little adventure party, a girl who takes on leadership responsibility, but seems the youngest among the group, looking only twelve or thirteen. She speaks in an unusually mature tone and carries herself like an experienced traveler and has the unquestioned trust of her party members. She always wears a fluffy white outfit regardless of the season, and somehow it neither gets dirty nor needs frequent changing. Sometimes, Arcana speaks in the tone reminiscent of an elderly, perhaps as a result of the strong influence of her elders?
char_getCharacter_10000160: I'm Fran, pleased to meet you, Conductor. By the way, where's Eliot?
char_resume_des_10000160_0_des: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA, currently stationed on The Eternal, and has a good relationship with Eliot. Fran is a shield bearer at the front line, appearing steady and reliable in combat. She is well-balanced in all aspects, both physically and mentally resilient. Filled with a strong sense of responsibility, she always leads the charge and protects teammates with her shield. Her back is a reassuring sight for her companions.
char_getCharacter_10000072: I'm Nayuta .As a member of the Source Citadel, I bring hope and light... Hmm, I actually can't do that sort of thing. Anyway, nice to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000072_0_des: Enigmatic visitor from the Source Citadel, a young man of few words. His whereabouts are a mystery, and his actions seem different from most of the Citadel members. Nayuta values efficiency and secrecy, and always operates alone. Through observing his daily life, it's apparent that he shares a close, almost familial relationship with Dustin and Sommer from the Source Citadel. According to BOX's combat data analysis, Nayuta's tactics against human enemies are more sophisticated than those for dealing with Chaos Remains...
char_getCharacter_10000094: I am... Sommer... I, I will... do my best...
char_resume_des_10000094_0_des: A member of the Destroyer, Source Citadel. She displayed her ascension ability at a young age. However, due to its unstable nature, she faced the risk of becoming a Deep Sleeper. Thanks to timely treatment by the Citadel, her condition was stabilized. However, her mutant left hand remains unhealed. Currently, she serves as a frontline combatant and shares a familial relationship with Dustin and Nayuta, who are also members of the Destroyer.
char_getCharacter_10000095: Yaho~~! I am Dorothy! I'll be counting on you from now on!
char_resume_des_10000095_0_des: Dorothy is a B.C.R.L Team Ratel member, serving as the demolition expert. Her fiery and boisterous personality is a perfect match for her role. Her laughter and voice can usually be heard from a carriage-length away. Be it at work or in daily life, she's a lively girl who keeps everyone on their toes. If you bump into her out in the field with a detonator switch in hand, duck immediately when she takes action, to avoid being caught in the blast.
char_getCharacter_10000111: I'm Galore. If you see "flamingo", you must let me know... No, not the kind with the color of my hair...
char_resume_des_10000111_0_des: Flamingo Pet Store is well-regarded among pet lovers in Shoggolith City. The owner, Galore, is known for his gentle and meticulous care of pets. It might be hard to imagine such kindness and patience existing under his cold and gloomy exterior, but he has undoubtedly earned praise from customers and trust from animals. Occasionally, Galore would suddenly showcase his magic tricks. Though judging from his level of expertise, it's clear that magic is more than just a hobby for him. Galore avoids communication as much as possible and rarely talks about himself.  However, his calmness and efficiency indicate he has the combat experience to handle any unexpected situations.
char_getCharacter_10000170: Greetings, Conductor. I'm Karen. Nice to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000170_0_des: B.C.R.L. Team Ratel member, Karen comes from a wealthy merchant family, so she still speaks with a slight tone of an heiress, even after much training at the camp. However, everyone is used to it and doesn't see Karen as an aloof person. Her admiration for Shizuru and determination to follow in her footsteps led Karen to join the B.C.R.L. training camp, where she put in hard work and passed the tests. Currently, her biggest worry, among all the trivial troubles, is how to get closer to Shizuru.
char_getCharacter_10000297: I am the "Demon Catcher," and I see there is a reservation order for The Eternal... You say there are no demons to catch on the train? Then just consider me a regular passenger.
char_resume_des_10000297_0_des: Reeva, the "Demon Catcher" from the Mundus Empire, is currently accepting various "demon capture" commissions in Bonfire City along the Western Loop Line. Whether it's unidentified creatures seen inside or outside of Bonfire City, or inexplicable anomalies found at home, they all seem to fall within this Demon Catcher's scope of work. As long as the client can specify the exact location of the incident, Reeva will go to track and handle them. With such powerful abilities, one would expect greater achievements in a higher position, however...
char_getCharacter_10000298: You're the Conductor? You don't look very reliable... Oh well. My name is Stella. Pleased to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000298_0_des: Anita Researcher studying Chaos Crystals. Stella had her independent lab at a young age. She is always full of energy, and is a young girl with aspirations. Occasionally boarding The Eternal while entering and exiting the Chaos Space and exploring new areas, she exudes an aura of perfection like a pampered girl refined down to every strand of hair. However, just like how beautifully maintained long hair requires a lot of care, Stella's life hasn't been smooth-sailing — though this might need time with her to comprehend fully.
char_getCharacter_10000299: Hello, Conductor. I am a researcher from BCRL, responsible for development... Oh, right, my name! I'm Rachel, pleased to meet you~
char_resume_des_10000299_0_des: As a Bonfire City Railways League researcher, Rachel is not required to engage in combat. However, to obtain firsthand data and improve her development of the supply reagent kit 'Rainbow Flask', she applied to join Team Meerkat. By working with Team Meerkat, which primarily handles support and special missions, Rachel was able to conduct experiments and collect data on the battlefield. Rachel's research is progressing well juding from the new colors she has developed for the 'Rainbow Flask'.
char_getCharacter_10000300: I'm Fenia! Charging ahead for the sake of world peace!
char_resume_des_10000300_0_des: Fenia's parents are Citadel scholars, making the Citadel's libraries and the giant Airship — Citadel Senanonic — her hometown. As her parents hoped, Fenia became an Ascender early on and was exceptionally talented. Growing up in the Citadel, she has the purest love for humanity but an undeniable hostility towards Chaos remains. To achieve the goal of annihilating all Chaos remains and protecting the world, Fenia joined the Destroyer and took the initiative to venture into the battlefield.
char_getCharacter_10000047: Hello, I'm Valentine. I serve as a Scribe at the Citadel.
char_resume_des_10000047_0_des: Valentine is one of the Citadel's scribes, responsible for cataloguing books in the Fabricate, essentially a librarian — She has an almost photographic memory when it comes to books, making her a walking book retrieval system. Whenever a visitor needs a book, she can find it quickly. She has also created a mini-library within the sea of academic books, specifically for books not included in the Fabricate.
char_getCharacter_10000387: Oh hello, Conductor, I'm Achiwa, a dropout with issues. Nice to meet you.
char_resume_des_10000387_0_des: Anita Energy Company intern Achiwa frequently travels between the Chaos Space and the real world for exploration and pioneering work. Her work mostly involves... rock crushing, so it seems. She carries an exploration tool resembling both a bat and a hammer, functioning as a weapon and tool. The weapon has significant explosive power and has been well-modified by its wielder. Based on the outer casing and additional components, it might also have advanced technological features — why does an intern's weapon have such latest tech? Did she pay for it herself?
char_getCharacter_10000388: Wensheng, accompanying you at the behest of Mr. Sagi. Hmm. Your scent... No, don't mind me.
char_resume_des_10000388_0_des: As Safety Director of Night Chains Hotel, Wensheng gives the impression of a dangerous and unapproachable person. Although the job might seem glamorous, everyone knows the shady business behind Night Chains Hotel and has the tacit understanding — "Being in post requires brains, strength, and guts." Hence, most are baffled when they see Wensheng expressionlessly playing a claw machine at a street corner store...
char_getCharacter_10000389: I'm Rina Von from the Citadel. Dispatched here to help... Um, is it true that you clock out on time here...?
char_resume_des_10000389_0_des: It's easy for Rina Von to come across as a powerful figure, given that she works for the Citadel, well-versed in various organizations' intelligence, and can provide rare social data. However, she claims recording such information is just a hobby and discourages exaggeration of her abilities. Though not a workaholic, Rina Von is a reliable doer, always completing tasks systematically.
char_getCharacter_10000409: I'm Shiu, code name "Tobinezumi", from Genuryu. Nice to meet you!
char_resume_des_10000409_0_des: As a ninja active in the shadows, Tobinezumi knows how to hide with various guises. She excels in disguise and impersonation, playing different roles to infiltrate or gather information. Her excellent skills and unpredictable appearance mean few know this quiet, shy girl is a skilled ninja.
char_getCharacter_10000352: I am the Citadel's pretty girl Suen! It's fine whether you're infatuated with me or admire me! But stalking is not okay!
char_resume_des_10000352_0_des: Girl from the Source Citadel, remembered for the strange patterns covering her body. Though she's just a child in terms of age, all test results show she has adult-like qualities, leading her to always act as an adult. Whether in the Citadel or on the train, the very friendly Suen can talk anyone's ear off. If someone shows curiosity about the patterns on her body, Suen will proudly and openly display them.
char_getCharacter_10000414: I am the inheritor of Mugenryu Ninjutsu, Shiki, aka Yamaarashi. The archenemy of Tobinezumi is me, Lord Yamaarashi! Ohohoho!
char_resume_des_10000414_0_des: The future inheritor of Mugenryu, hidden in the city, the pillar of the detective agency — Shiki, also known as Lord Yamaarashi! Whether honing ninja skills or detective work, it must be the best, in particular, better than her rival Tobinezumi! To this end, no matter the obstacle before her, she advances resolutely on the path of justice... Can I become an action movie star?! Why would Lord Yamaarashi want to b-become an action star?! Surpassing Tobinezumi in ninja skills is enough, and nothing else matters for the sole inheritor of Mugenryu! Forget what I said!
char_getCharacter_10000408: Bionic Operator X activated. Please select the voice profile for the android dialogue system from the settings.
char_resume_des_10000408_0_des: BOX (Bionic Operator X) is a multi-functional android developed by B.C.R.L. Research Department and Anita Tech to assist humans in various technical tasks. It has many derivative models, but due to its high cost, it hasn't been widely adopted. BOX equipped on the train can assist the conductor in operating the train, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs.
char_getCharacter_10000739: Hello, I'm Verlaine. I'm currently on my travels and hitching a ride on this trip!... By the way, are my friends here?
char_resume_des_10000739_0_des: Unlike most Ascenders, Verlaine's ascension ability has a unique expression and functionality, as seen in the hound-like creature accompanying her. The hound Monday is not a real animal or a man-made companion robot but an extension of Verlaine's ability. Her companion. This uniqueness leads to some issues — she is destined not to blend in with ordinary people and lacks common ground with most Ascenders. However, her lively and cheerful personality seems unaffected. According to her, it's all because of the precious friends by her side.
char_getCharacter_10000335: I'm Yejue, dispatched by Anita Global Energy. Conductor, right? Nice to meet you!
char_resume_des_10000335_0_des: Pathfinder from Anita Energy Company wielding exploration equipment, she occasionally boards The Eternal on her way back to her Anita dormitory from the Chaos Space. She maintains a cheerful older sister demeanor in both work and life, a contrast to her partner Caroline's temperament. As a pragmatic doer, her dream is to become a successful person who can afford a big house, making her very concerned about salary, promotions, raises, and other material things... According to her, all her efforts are to make money. However, this honesty is reassuring. At least once paid, she completes her work earnestly — provided she doesn't argue with her partner midway.
char_getCharacter_10000027: ...Haruka, that's my name. Maintenance is my job, and you just focus on yours.
char_resume_des_10000027_0_des: A famous ghost crew member of The Eternal, working as a COLUMBA train repair technician, and the owner of the Blue Cat, Dodo. These three identities make up Haruka's exceptionally simple life. Her lack of presence and non-existent social initiative make her someone that is overlooked. But she has no complaints about it and is content with the status quo. When it comes to repairing trains, Haruka is the most reliable partner.
char_getCharacter_10000031: I'm Joshua. As an Angel of the Citadel, I can teach you profound knowledge that ordinary people can't understand. Please refrain from asking, "Teacher, what does this mean~" or other similarly silly questions.
char_resume_des_10000031_0_des: Literally a floating crew member from the Citadel, an "Angel". Goes about most daily activities floating in the air. This individual used to be called Joshua, but now that has become a code name — after all, feedback from some former colleagues and friends claims that the current Joshua is completely different from the one they knew. Also, all information about the Angel must remain confidential, and any written material unvetted by Joshua is considered invalid. Thus, this archive entry refers to Joshua as "they" and "the individual". Kindly note this.
char_getCharacter_10000034: Yo, I am Hayabusa. Aren't you going to welcome me?
char_resume_des_10000034_0_des: A mysterious young man who comes and goes without a trace. Perpetrator of many bad deeds and few good ones — good and evil are so ambiguous to him that all accusations against him seem weak and meaningless. Simply classifying him as a cunning enemy is not quite right, but treating him as a friend too soon is recipe for exploitation with worse consequences. No matter how strong or mysterious a person is, one would have a past and weaknesses. What secrets lie in Hayabusa's past? And what unimaginable weakness does he have?
char_getCharacter_10000051: We meet again, Conductor. I'm Arina, the bartender.
char_resume_des_10000051_0_des: Arina seems to be an ever-present member of the Night Chains, but on closer inspection, it's clear her actions are in sync with the Conductor's. When the Conductor returns to The Eternal, she would often be waiting on the train with a smile. Arina's ascension ability allows her to summon three phantoms. Customers are often startled by multiple Arinas when they first enter the lounge — however, the drinks she prepares are delicious, making it easy for people to let their guard down and open up to her. Whether this is a prelude to getting close to her or falling into a trap... only time will tell.
char_getCharacter_10000052: I'm Nabi, tasked to assist you with your work. Orders, please.
char_resume_des_10000052_0_des: Nabi, the Night Chains Executor, doesn't serve the large organization directly. She has another identity that she prioritizes over her role as Executor, and that is Hayabusa's bodyguard, even though it's a role assigned by someone else. She dresses simply and does things in a straightforward manner. She rarely engages in unnecessary interactions. You might occasionally see Nabi sitting by a window, sketching with a pencil — one of her few hobbies.
char_getCharacter_10000053: Hello, Conductor, I'm Yer from Anita. Please allocate a private workspace for me and instruct other crew members not to enter during working hours.
char_resume_des_10000053_0_des: Yer specialises on drone development. Unlike gardeners who stay in a lab for extended periods, she travels frequently between research bases to assist with everyone's research and operations, establishing good relationships with many colleagues. As one whose action speaks louder than words, Yer comes across as competent and reliable. Although she maintains appropriate distance from others, it does not stop her from being a trusted figure.
char_getCharacter_10000101: Hello, I'm Kaleya from Anita. If there's anything I can help you with, feel free to ask.
char_resume_des_10000101_0_des: With her youthful appearance and usual outfit, Kaleya is often mistaken by those who don't know her as a new intern nurse in Anita. In reality, she is a capable Gardener familiar with the Chaos world's environment, and often provides her comrades with environmental support. Gentle, generous, and knowledgeable, Kaleya is popular and trusted by her colleagues. Perhaps to compensate for the regret of being unable to use her physician's license, Kaleya is always eager to offer medical support when needed.
char_getCharacter_10000110: Lin. That's my name... Um, that's about it...
char_resume_des_10000110_0_des: As a Night Chains executor, Lin comes across as a very introverted girl. She rarely communicates or cooperates with others and shows little emotional fluctuation. This isn't surprising in a group like Night Chains where many prefer working alone. Her exquisite albeit low-key fashion sense, her occasional emotional outbursts that startle those around her, and her calm demeanor when facing bloody scenes suggest that Lin is quite a unique girl.
char_getCharacter_10000112: Captain of B.C.R.L Team Meerkat, Ganya. I haven't prepared any gifts, so don't plan some welcome ceremony. Let's just get down to work.
char_resume_des_10000112_0_des: Captain of B.C.R.L. Team Meerkat. Unlike the more mobile Team Ratel, Team Meerkat deals with logistics and special situations. Ganya was chosen as Team Meerkat's captain for several reasons: she is from Mander Mine, excelled in training camp, and has performed well in her job. She is responsible and steady. Amongst the problematic Team Meerkat, Ganya stands out as the normal one. However, Rachel, Ilona, and Reika all trust and like this captain, though Reika may never admit it.
char_getCharacter_10000035: I am Dustin from the Source Citadel, revealing Hope to the world is my mission. Please take care of me in the future, Conductor.
char_resume_des_10000035_0_des: The Citadel's core personnel and leader of Destroyer — Dustin. Based on his appearance, it is difficult to determine if he's still human. His limbs, skin, and even some organs have been replaced by machinery, leaving only a few traces of his human identity. If everything has a reason, then Dustin sacrificed so much to survive and continue fighting to create a peaceful world for the children — Thus, he's willing to pay any price to guide and accompany the children he loves towards the future.
char_getCharacter_10000032: I'm Nicola. Fear not, these weapons are in non-lethal mode.
char_resume_des_10000032_0_des: Head of Anita Energy Institute, an expert in the fields of chaos stone and energy, and the inventor with the most patents in Anita. However, Nicola is not bothered by these titles, so she doesn't take action as the Head, doesn't attend research meetings, and even stuffs her patent applications into a safe, never to open them again. If she's spotted outside, it must be to pursue something truly close to her heart... such as newly released plush toys and new flavors of potato products, or indispensable research collaborators.
char_getCharacter_10000124: Ta-da~ Anita's heartthrob — Akira, makes a dazzling appearance!
char_resume_des_10000124_0_des: Anita's most popular heartthrob, a striking fashion icon, a perfect, empathic genius, and a graceful skiing prince. Yes, this is Akira's... one-sided story. If you ask those who know him, you'd probably hear things like, "he's talented but always messes up at critical moments," "always concerned with looking cool in combat," and "honestly, he's a bit noisy"... comments that are far from glamorous and, according to Akira, totally uncool.
char_getCharacter_10000139: Hello, Conductor, I'm Anita's Pathfinder, Caroline. Nice to meet you!
char_resume_des_10000139_0_des: Pathfinder from Anita Energy Company, young and sharp-eyed, holding a flag-shaped exploration beacon, with a polite robot dog following behind. Compared to her mature and cautious partner, Caroline is livelier, though that's an understatement. From Yejue's complaints and helpless comments from other Anita employees, it's clear that Caroline trusts her first instinct over extensive planning and hours of waiting for instrument results. Maybe this is also a way of following her heart — Caroline's dream is to keep venturing into uncharted territories.
char_getCharacter_10000159: Bionic Operator X activated. Please select the voice profile for the android dialogue system from the settings.
char_resume_des_10000159_0_des: After modification, BOX is now called Box Excalibur (note: its weapon has no holy attributes). Equipped with a large close-combat weapon, the connection point is fortified to prevent the sword-shaped weapon from loosening or falling off, allowing flexible wielding in combat. Additionally, it has been upgraded with the latest multi-functional android mechanic upgrade disk from B.C.R.L., enabling it to adapt to more complex battlefield environments and better assist in combat.
char_identity_10000254: Turbulent Sea – Deputy Chief of P.U.S. (self-proclaimed)
char_getCharacter_10000254: Ah! That scary Conductor?! How are you here?! ...Oh, I get it! You're planning to change careers and become a subordinate of my Lord Shire, right?
char_resume_des_10000254_0_des: A member of the P.U.S., her origin, ascension ability, and true identity are shrouded in mystery. Typically, she would be classified as a potential threat and subject to permanent surveillance. However, due to her exceptional contribution in resolving an incident involving the Eternal CBCRR23 train crew, she has been temporarily designated as part of the crew's support staff and granted licensed crew member access. As she may not possess full civil capacity yet, the rest of the crew is encouraged to exercise tolerance and supervise her conduct to support her healthy development.
char_identity_10000270: B.C.R.L. – Shoggolith City BCRL Agency Administrator
char_getCharacter_10000270: I am Heinrich, the head of the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith, temporarily residing on The Eternal. Given our trust relationship, I believe no further introduction is necessary.
char_resume_des_10000270_0_des: Before visiting the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith City, one can easily discover Heinrich's reputation by pointing to the renowned B.C.R.L. recruitment poster and asking, 'Ohh! Who's that?' The question would yield various responses. Some would identify him as the head of the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith City, while others would describe him as a war hero and a model soldier from the old days. However, upon meeting this living legend in person, one would be impressed by his down-to-earth attitude, as well as the restraint and friendliness commonly found in a typical soldier, as he is always ready to extend help as part of his duty.
char_getCharacter_10000276: I'm Tennie. I look forward to working with you from now on. Can train weapons get a discount? That's not something I can decide, silly!
char_resume_des_10000276_0_des: Those who frequent the train weapon factory in the Mander Mine will undoubtedly recall the presence of a blonde girl. Tennie stands out among the gritty train mechanics with her long blonde hair, vibrant highlights, distinctive clothing style, and boisterous voice... These unique attributes make Tennie easily recognizable in the arsenal. In addition, she holds the position of chief technician. When summoned, she emerges from piles of tools and half-finished products to assist the visiting conductor.
char_ability_10000372: Mind Palace, Communication with Chaos Remains (Self-proclaimed)
char_getCharacter_10000372: I am Anfiya, currently on a study tour... A box? Inside the box are Anfiya's friends, so don't worry about it.
char_resume_des_10000372_0_des: Anfiya, an intern at Anita Energy Company, has her personal information marked as 'inaccessible for public' upon special request. Additionally, the two special devices she carries have successfully passed testing and have been approved for use as 'research aid gadgets,' provided they do not present a threat to others. Polarization detectors may set off alarms when near Anfiya and her research devices. In such cases, inspect the surrounding area for potential threats and deactivate the polarization detectors when there are no identified threats. Currently, Anfiya has been granted special permission to serve as a temporary crew member on the Eternal.
char_getCharacter_10000468: I don't look the same anymore? But I'm always going to be Shizuru regardless... Anyhow, I'm pleased to see you, even while in this state.
char_resume_des_10000468_0_des: The captain of Team Ratel, a model squad of the BCRL. She has overseen her squad's rapid transformation from a rookie unit to one of BCRL's most promising teams. Her tactical skills have also shown steady improvement. However, even the most accomplished commander needs breaks from time to time. At the request of her team members, she has finally accepted a well-deserved respite. Building a deeper understanding of her could lay the groundwork for ongoing relationship in the future.
char_getCharacter_10000499: I'm Jalhay, a... a subject of the Citadel. I'm Harle's sister...
char_resume_des_10000499_0_des: Subject SC-002 is characterized as a female human approximately 16 years of age, sporting lengthy grayish-white hair (extending to the upper arm's length). Currently rated as ████, indicating permission for interaction with the external world and humans, SC-002 must be accompanied by a qualified guarantor and guardian. The subject must wear a ████ device provided by the guarantor ████ or maintain a connection to the ████ device in any circumstances. Note: As per the request from the guarantor and other related parties, the subject is addressed as 'Jalhay' in unspecified settings.
char_identity_10000503: Source Citadel – Scholar of Ascension Faction
char_getCharacter_10000503: I am Ithos. You have many valuable samples in your car. Not allowed? It doesn't matter; I will always manage to gain your consent.
char_resume_des_10000503_0_des: The Ascension Faction is a cardinal academic faction of Source Citadel, but in comparison with their colleagues, the Ascension Faction's researchers seem to be even more radical when it comes to means and viewpoints. By the standards of society, they are without a doubt unscrupulous.As a scholar in this faction, Ithos doesn't exactly have an amiable demeanor, which makes it understandable why he isn't well-liked by others. Still, there are some unsettling rumors that surround him—a researcher who used his family as lab rats, an amoral, horrifying murderer... But he has never once responded to these accusations.
char_getCharacter_10000607: Paladi reporting! Starting today, I'm a crew member of The Eternal—huh? Reforming Center? No worries, no worries, the surveillance robot will watch the house for me!
char_resume_des_10000607_0_des: Upon entering the Reforming Center, any visitors will be impressed by a multitude of cameras lining the corridors and rooms, complemented by surveillance robots patrolling various areas. The architect of this extensive network is Paladi, a long-haired individual sporting a cloak and oversized hat. Easily recognizable by her distinctively loud voice and rowdy laughter, she stands out in any setting.
char_getCharacter_10000546: I am Ikoma. ...What? More introductions? Then there's no need for that...! I will work hard and fight diligently. After all, I still have ideals I want to achieve!
char_resume_des_10000546_0_des: A self-proclaimed mechanic of the Koutetsujou, Ikoma did his best to share his background and experience with The Eternal crew, but everything he disclosed was outside of anyone's comprehension.He fought alongside The Eternal crew and provided loads of technological and combat assistance during the series of events that occurred near Ranshin City.At present, Ikoma is temporarily traveling with The Eternal while searching for a way to return to his train.
char_getCharacter_10000615: I'm Pelota, but you can call me Ballie if you'd like to! I'm pretty awesome and definitely useful!... Oh, by the way, are all the electronic devices on your train insured?
char_resume_des_10000615_0_des: This document certifies that Pelota (born on September 5, ■■■■, adult) currently holds the position of Special Agent within Gardener. She has been a regular employee of our organization for the past two consecutive years. Effective immediately, Pelota is designated as a crew member aboard the Eternal for a period of ■■ days. During her assignment, she will comply with the laws and regulations of bonfire cities and the Eternal. We undertake to indemnify her against any accidental damages within the scope of the contract. The terms of this arrangement are detailed in the document titled "Memorandum on Matters Concerning Pelota's Special Dispatch."
char_getCharacter_10000623: I am Gold. What? Know me? But this, first meet. ...Just joking! Yes. I learn, jokes, Conductor. Happy, be your friend.
char_resume_des_10000623_0_des: An old nugget mech model manufactured around 25 years ago that used to serve ONEderland and its surrounding areas. Primarily in charge of the other nugget mechs' work as a whole. Owing to her adorable appearance, she was widely celebrated as "Ms. Gold" by the workers during the gold rush. Although ONEderland fell into decline for two decades, she continued maintaining the operation of the station and its nearby facilities. Her components and exterior are in various degrees of disrepair due to her excessive length of service and perpetual exposure to morphic field pollution. After undergoing partial maintenance and upgrading, she is now working as a crew member on The Eternal as a COLUMBA employee.
char_getCharacter_10000624: I'm Mumei, temporarily serving as a bodyguard here. Ah, payment won't be necessary. Just provide me with adequate food and a place to sleep.
char_resume_des_10000624_0_des: A mysterious girl claiming to have come from "Koutetsujou". During the events occurred near Ranshin City, numerous people witnessed her combat ability no weaker to that of an Ascender, but her identity, background, and the truth behind her ability remain a mystery. At present, Mumei is temporarily traveling with the Eternal while searching for a way to return to her train.
char_getCharacter_10000632: I am Raziel. Although I'm not sure what exactly I can help with on The Eternal... but I hope to at least slightly lighten the burden on your shoulders.
char_resume_des_10000632_0_des: Raziel, a mentor of Source Citadel. Used to be the resident mentor aboard the floating city, Senanonic.In recent years, she volunteered to become the guardian of housed subject SC-002 (commonly known as 'Jalhay'). From then on, to ensure the safety and stability of SC-002, she and SC-002 moved to live in the Confluence Tower together.On account of her stellar reputation within Source Citadel, her living and research environments were specially retained in recognition of her contribution.May Raziel complete her guardianship duties toward SC-002 as swiftly as possible, alongside her relevant research, and return to Senanonic soon.
char_getCharacter_10000749: The adventure story that belongs to me and the Great Savior is about to begin!
char_resume_des_10000749_0_des: Failed Angel entity, Ushana. Has been known to lose control multiple times and is hence determined to be a highly dangerous entity. However, as she has remained virtually lucid in recent years, she is specially approved to work alongside other typical Citadel members.During the LRA-00 incident, this entity exhibited extraordinary admiration and devotion toward CBCRR23 The Eternal's conductor, thus leading to a series of consequences, including damage to the restriction system, but the matter pretty much did not negatively affect the entity's state of mind.After the incident, the entity passed basic stability tests and received special approval to stay on CBCRR23 The Eternal, on the condition that she put on specific equipment and kept the SOAP system activated at all times.
char_getCharacter_10000748: I am Raziel, that's what they told me. It seems like I caused you some trouble before, though I can't quite remember...
char_resume_des_10000748_0_des: Failed Angel entity, Raziel. Determined to be a failed transformation subject during LRA-00 and precipitated a ■-level incident and a series of dangerous events within Haima Zaria.However, with the efforts of CBCRR23 The Eternal's conductor and Source Citadel members who made it in time, LRA-00 was successfully resolved and did not cause any additional casualties.As this entity was once a Source Citadel mentor and is acquainted with CBCRR23 The Eternal's conductor, she has received special approval to stay on The Eternal, provided her mental state remains stable, and to be kept under observation and accept regular treatments.
char_getCharacter_10000969: Lycagia reporting! From today onwards, I am a member of The Eternal. As for the reason... haha, I'll explain it to you later, okay? Please take care of me, Conductor!
char_resume_des_10000969_0_des: A tall wolf demi-human with an outgoing and straightforward personality. Even among the BCRL Agency, where soldiers are generally of outstanding quality, Lycagia stands out for his exceptional physical fitness and combat abilities. By fully leveraging the superior physical qualities of a demi-human, he has achieved remarkable results in both team-led and solo combat operations. Additionally, through years of work at the BCRL Agency, he has gained extensive experience dealing with various forces. When encountering problems that are difficult to solve independently, one can confidently seek his assistance.
char_ability_10000979: The Secret Abilities of a Professional Maid
char_getCharacter_10000979: I am Olivien, and I will be working on The Eternal from now on. How should I address you—"Master"?
char_resume_des_10000979_0_des: Olivien, a guard crew member who signed a special employment contract with the Boundless. Before this, she was the acting manager of a Flamingo pet shop and also managed a maid café; if we look further back, her resume and experiences are simply glossed over as "several employment experiences." What exactly fills this suspicious gap?—To ask this question, one must first contend with black tea at the perfect temperature, freshly baked pastries, and a comfortably arranged sofa...
char_getCharacter_10000855: Hello, I am Ren. …… Please arrange for me to be in the area with the min people.
char_resume_des_10000855_0_des: A young Night Chains enforcer with a uniquely styled outfit. If you overlook the seemingly hefty weapon in her hand, she might just appear to be an ordinary girl enthusiastic about fashion. However, as the number of combat quests she undertakes increases, it quickly becomes apparent from the extent of destruction in her surrounding environment that the term "ordinary girl" is quite far from accurate. How should such a heart be treated to gain peace?
char_getCharacter_10000572: Conductor, conductor! Hmm~? I'm not cosplaying, this is the true appearance of Witch Margiela!
char_resume_des_10000572_0_des: As the executor of Night Chains and the owner of "Pupil", Margiela has gained recognition and trust from everyone in various roles. Now, she no longer needs to play the image of an ideal; she has already become a true witch. However, this doesn't mean she has given up her love for role-playing—the brief transformation that brings a character into reality is a miracle that the magic cannot replace, bringing others profound emotion.
char_getCharacter_10000573: Conductor, I am Wheat—no no no, I'm not here to drive the tow truck today! Ahem!—Starting today, I am Wheat, a crew member of The Eternal. Please take care of me!
char_resume_des_10000573_0_des: As the Conductor and members of the BCRL know, tow truck drivers are considered one of the toughest "on-road jobs" in the BCRL. Even when assignments are semi-mandatory, this job is often unwelcome—after all, who would willingly choose to endure long hours of loneliness and take on such a tedious and dangerous task? Under these circumstances, Mai's appearance is like a ray of golden, fragrant sunshine; as long as her furry face appears, it seems that all difficulties and dangers vanish. When encountering danger or breaking down in the wild, just call for the tow truck driver Mai over communications!
char_identity_10000796: The following content needs translation: Night Chains·Part-timer
char_getCharacter_10000796: Hello. I haven't introduced myself before, my name is Masaki Kamishiro. "Witch"? She's also here with me. However, I hope you'll address me by my current name. Hmm... Please call me Masaki.
char_resume_des_10000796_0_des: A young girl introduced to Night Chains by Margiela. Originally, Masaki did not meet the age requirements for official employees of Night Chains, but with the strong guidance and help of Goethe, this special girl gained the title of "part-time student." Now, she is often seen moving between the various facilities of Night Chains Land, smiling and offering assistance to visitors. Seeing Masaki's adorable smile lifts everyone's spirits—who could say that's not the most wonderful magic?
char_getCharacter_10000843: Chloe, the Citadel's Angel, this is my profile, take it and have a look yourself.
char_resume_des_10000843_0_des: During the transformation process of the special Angel individual Chloe, an accident occurred, leading to the Hayma Dice going out of control, thus halting the transformation procedure. Given the stable and irreplaceable connection between this individual and Unbewusstes, and considering that her current self-awareness ability is unobstructed, it has been acknowledged after discussion that she substantially holds the "Angel" identity. At the individual's request, the Citadel renounces the Use of the special Angel title and code name for her and appoints her as a special Vanguard responsible for disaster management.
char_birthday_10000890: Unclear/to be determined after discussion as the end of the year day
char_getCharacter_10000890: Ikara, here as the representative of the Green Realm Alliance and the future intern Conductor. …When I was traveling, someone told me to address those who graduated earlier at school as seniors… Should I call you that too?
char_resume_des_10000890_0_des: A mysterious member of the Extraction Alliance from a far corner of the Empire. Since the first Day she arrived on The Eternal, curiosity about her identity has never vanished. She has the distinct appearance of an Imperial (or even a Reverberator) and possesses incredible combat abilities, yet almost no other Imperials know anything about her past. All information about her is classified at the highest level on The Eternal, with only a handful able to access it... and you are the only one here who has witnessed her true form.
char_getCharacter_10000920: I am Eliade from Anita, and I am very happy to assist you with any questions within my capability.
char_resume_des_10000920_0_des: A renowned metaphysical particle researcher, an important member of the second department "Gardeners" at Anita Energy Company, and also a mentor. Many young people in the "Gardeners" have received his guidance and support, and the students he has personally trained have gradually become key talents in various research projects. Contrary to his youthful and handsome appearance, he is actually middle-aged. He joined Anita many years ago before the Western Loop Line was completed, but it was this opportunity that led him to the Freeport Seven incident, which changed his life. What exactly keeps him going? What is he truly pursuing?
char_getCharacter_10000942: I am the mechanical god walking among humans! Bow down to my power!
char_resume_des_10000942_0_des: A mysterious girl claims to be the commander of the Saisannik army and the seventh cardinal of the Holy See. After being guaranteed and certified by the conductor of CBCRR Train No. 23 and the conductor's assistant, she is temporarily identified as a special individual from another world. She was initially discovered in the vicinity of the village of Yinlin (tentative name) and was experiencing severe rejection of her morphic field, even exhibiting physical dissociation phenomena. After a series of events, this individual's morphic field has now stabilized; currently, with the individual's voluntary consent, she is temporarily registered as a guard crew member of The Eternal.
char_getCharacter_10001003: Greetings, I am Helena, a gem mage from the Mundus Empire—here is a letter of recommendation and a meeting gift, please accept them without hesitation.
char_resume_des_10001003_0_des: A mysterious magician from the Mundus Empire, who claims to be currently on a journey; she is also a mature business investor with substantial assets and owns a gemstone shop, along with numerous other ventures not accounted for. During interactions with a mysterious race residing in Yinyan Village (tentative name), she provided consultation and assistance to the crew of The Eternal and a certain mysterious outlander. After experiencing a series of subsequent events with the Conductor of The Eternal, Ms. Helena chose to register as a crew member of The Eternal.
char_getCharacter_10001052: Yes, I finally gained permission to fight alongside the crew of The Eternal. ... On the journey ahead, if there is anything that needs to be done, please don't hesitate to give me orders directly.
char_resume_des_10001052_0_des: Chelsea, a young scholar of the Source Citadel, is also a student of Raziel, who was once a scholar and is now one of the fallen angel individuals. In the past, she accepted a transfer to the Apoaster Bridge under Raziel's support and encouragement, but since then, she has been despondent. Upon learning that Raziel personally became a participant in the Angel Plan and failed in the transformation, Chelsea even fell into a breakdown for a time—these events and their outcomes compounded and influenced each other, ultimately becoming the inducement for her drastic change in personality and committing mistakes that require Judgment.
char_getCharacter_10001019: Ah, we meet again... I'm so happy.
char_resume_des_10001019_0_des: ■■■■, a former member of Anita's second department (later seconded to the fifth department), experienced significant changes in the individual Morphic Field following a series of incidents. Currently, according to their (or the individual's) wishes, this individual will henceforth be referred to by the code name "Doramis." Special attention is required, as this individual has developed a new self-awareness and cognition; therefore, it is necessary to respect the individual's judgments, decisions, and actions, and not to interact with them using past social methods.
char_getCharacter_10000941: 虽然对于无垠号来说我是初来乍到……但我在阿妮塔姑且是你的导师哦……要一如既往地加油呀，列车长！
char_resume_des_10000941_0_des: 年轻而可靠的小个子导师，在初入阿妮塔的实习生和新人之间享有“盛誉”。一方面时萝因为无微不至的讲解和照顾被新人们信赖着，但另一方面，她也因为对“孩子们”太过细致入微的关心时不时成为大家避之不及的存在。另外，时萝在自己的研究方向上也是一位颇有建树的年轻学者，早年间便发布了重要的研究成果，现在已是现实稳定装置的民用化、便携化项目推广的主要人士之一。
char_identity_10001157: 柯米提斯国·至高仲裁官
char_getCharacter_10001157: 柯米提斯至高裁判官赫卡蒂，以群星与审判之名前来指引各位。
char_resume_des_10001157_0_des: 自称“至高仲裁官”的年轻女性，甫一到达篝火城便在人群中引起了轩然大波。经一番波折后与科伦巴商会达成信赖与合作关系，被确认为来自不同世界的“异乡来客”，出现轻度的形态场排斥现象，但在服用原质之果以后形态场趋于稳定。经由本人同意后，现于西大陆铁路环线一带以科伦巴商会实习生身份活动。
char_getCharacter_10001089: 我、我是奉星使，嘉尔……您好，那个……抱歉，我只是有点，紧张……请您相信我的奇迹……
char_resume_des_10001089_0_des: 年纪尚小的奉星使，在来到篝火城后因为畏惧与人沟通而一度流落街头，但因在意外中展现出不俗的战斗能力而受到翠境联盟关注。经一番波折后与科伦巴商会达成信赖与合作关系，被确认为来自不同世界的“异乡来客”，出现轻度的形态场排斥现象，但在服用原质之果以后形态场趋于稳定。经由本人同意后，现于西大陆铁路环线一带以科伦巴商会实习生身份活动。
char_getCharacter_10001092: 你好你好，吃饭没有呀？别管报道不报道的了，我给你带了吃的……衣服？哎呀，这些都是小事，来喝汤啦先！
char_resume_des_10001092_0_des: 阿妮塔导师、卓越的桦树生物研究者，形态污染预防和治疗研究专家。关于她的一切家庭关系和经历背景档案，以及基于当年七号自由港爆炸事故中意外的调查报告，均基于其意愿留档封存，不得在无本人允许的情况下对外公开。另，阿妮塔能源公司已安排为其购买当前市面上所有形式的人身以及意外保险，无垠号及科伦巴商会进行人事移交时可参阅乘员合同的附属条款以进一步了解详情。
char_identity_10001203: 阿妮塔能源·发射中心管理人
char_getCharacter_10001203: 沃斯托克大人驾到~！怎么样，吓到你了吧？这次我还给你带来了好多好东西——但是，拜托你先让我去车上，然后我们再继续聊吧！
char_resume_des_10001203_0_des: 阿妮塔发射中心的实际管理人，同时也是阿妮塔航天部门所剩不多的研究人员之一。沃斯托克常常被描述为一个开朗乐观、善于鼓舞士气的领导者，有她在的地方，基本都能确保气氛轻松愉快、同事关系和睦友好。但面对航天业数十年来都缺少进展的残酷现实，人们还是不禁发问：这种乐观主义真的是有效的吗？而沃斯托克，又打算带领她的同事们坚持到什么时候？
char_identity_10001222: 曼杜斯帝国·骑士屋成员
char_getCharacter_10001222: 前随从骑士、现骑士屋的成员，蒂丝塔尔向您报道。请允许我和夏洛蒂前辈一同战斗！啊，对了，我还可以替您整理内务，您需要时请直接叫我。
char_resume_des_10001222_0_des: 无论你是从夏洛蒂口中听说过她，还是经由骑士屋以及萃境联盟的事务与她本人结识，蒂丝塔尔的表现都绝对不会让你失望。她的工作范围之广令人震惊，上到战斗护卫、下到洗涤打扫，无论大事小事她都能处理得井井有条——不过，从她独处时常常露出的可爱微笑来看，这位少女心中的某个角落，是否也藏着一些隐秘的心事呢？
equip_des_11800028: A high-powered revolver for hunting large monsters, difficult for ordinary people to handle.
equip_des_11800030: A rock from the chaos space, with extremely high hardness, perfect for delivering the final blow to opponents.
equip_des_11800032: Tech from the Citadel, magic from the Empire, mediation from the Earth Union. The three major powers serve this weapon. The user gains combat experience from the three major powers, becoming more courageous with each combat.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800034: A mysterious technological artifact from a world without morphic resonance. After simple repairs by EU Tech, it emits a mysterious signal, but attempts at reverse engineering have failed. Its design does not conform to the laws of physics in this world, but it occasionally receives messages from another world. That world seems to be aware of our existence and is observing us.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800043: BCRL's standard military equipment. When soldiers run out of ammunition, at least this knife can still be relied upon.
equip_des_11800044: A portable ration with an unsatisfactory taste, it quickly replenishes the energy lost by the consumer after defeating enemies.
equip_des_11800045: A former superpower Northern Alliance's weapon developed using nuclear tech listed in the "109 Dangerous Technologies That Could Destroy the World" by the Citadel. It can self-charge rapidly. Its data and other replicas have been retrieved and destroyed by the Citadel.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800046: A concentrated functional beverage with a unique taste, it quickly replenishes the energy lost by the consumer after defeating enemies.
equip_des_11800047: A component attached to grenades, enhancing their explosive power when detonated.
equip_des_11800048: Wearing this material, individuals can maintain a morphic field similar to a Deep Sleeper, enabling more efficient energy utilization when releasing energy-consuming abilities.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800096: Used by a legendary veteran, whose morphic field influenced this weapon. It will gradually make the user as valiant and skilled in combat as she is.
equip_des_11800098: Used by a sturdy lumberjack, whose morphic field influenced this tool. It will gradually make the user as robust and agile as he is.
equip_des_11800102: Armor developed by a former superpower Northern Alliance. When the target loses vital signs, it can obtain a stable human body structure's morphic field from the opponent.
equip_des_11800103: Utilizes morphic field tech to recover energy on the battlefield for personal equipment use.
equip_des_11800104: Produced by the EU from an unknown timeline, anyone who uses it feels comfortable and agile in combat.
equip_des_11800105: Armor made of Degenerate Blackrock. Extremely hard armor that can save lives in critical moments.
equip_des_11800106: Surgical tool made with the abilities of an Ascender medic. Allows ordinary individuals without medical knowledge to perform emergency surgery on the battlefield.
equip_des_11800107: Equipped with a lifesign detection function, it automatically injects adrenaline to the wearer when life-threatening situations occur, temporarily uplifting their spirits and making their movements more agile.
equip_des_11800035: A small pistol developed by Anita Tech in the past, specifically for use in harsh environments. It's sturdy, portable, and capable of rapid firing.
equip_des_11800036: How to impart acceleration to objects has long been a subject of study for the Citadel. Over the years, the Citadel has designed numerous devices, large and small, for this purpose. This device is widely regarded as simple, efficient, and easy to produce. Of course, it can also be used as a weapon, as any moving object requires external force to stop.
equip_des_11800037: A staff used by apprentice mages of the Empire.
equip_des_11800038: Used by executors of Night Chains, coated with potent poison.
equip_des_11800039: Carried by Gardener for various tasks, initially developed by pioneer Gardener exploring the chaos space, it has been improved over time to include welding, cutting, and combat functions. To prevent accidental injuries, it must be stored in a wooden case when not in use.
equip_des_11800237: A coating that can adhere to any surface, known for its lightweight and heat-resistant properties, originally developed as a coating material for spacecraft. Now widely used in Anita's protective suits, equipment, and vehicles, it enhances the defensive capabilities of the objects it covers.
equip_des_11800238: Worn on the chest, it activates a special morphic field to protect the wearer from harm when their life signs are detected to be weakening.
equip_des_11800239: Weather weapon designed by Anita. Increases the chance of summoning lightning, although it cannot output full power due to a lack of grounding conductors. But isn't the user's body an excellent conductor? Just make sure not to cause any step voltage situations.
equip_des_11800240: Used by the Gardener to harvest organs from Chaos Remains to create Chaos Stone equipment, it efficiently recovers energy. Scientists assure that as Chaos Remains lack the neural structure of Earth organisms, they do not experience any pain during the organ harvesting process.
equip_des_11800241: Non-physical fibers woven from pure morphic field. Stabilizes the structure of objects it covers, maintaining stability and minimizing damage or worse consequences as much as possible.
equip_des_11800242: Equipped with the Anita command system, it coordinates the efficiency of surrounding drones' operations.
equip_des_11800243: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, also a technology for cooling the reality stabilizer. The higher the machine's power, the colder it becomes.
equip_des_11800244: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, if not supplied with a large amount of energy to sustain it, it will continuously absorb heat from the environment until it melts itself.
equip_des_11800245: Experimental product of Anita's attempt to restore ancient artifacts. Although it did not achieve the goal of restoration, Anita successfully produced this almost indestructible armor material. When activated, its surface reflects light similar to that of the distant stars.
equip_des_11800246: A drone with a monopole magnetic core made from Chaos Stone, capable of charging all surrounding drones.
equip_des_11800247: This prototype is the outcome of Anita's efforts to analyze a technological creation of unknown origin from the chaos space. Under specific resonance conditions, it can emit a unique energy beam capable of eradicating either a portion or the entirety of its target's existence.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800248: Originally an Anita spatial anchor, this device underwent anomalies that led to its modification into a spear. It serves the purpose of summoning supplies whenever and wherever necessary. Occasionally, it summons items bearing the Anita logo, despite never having been manufactured.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800249: Equipment made from advanced varietal Chaos Remains' brain. Worn behind the head, it allows the user's brainwaves to temporarily mimic hive mind thinking. Anita created this equipment primarily to facilitate the coordination of numerous drones.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800250: Experimental product from the Citadel's attempt to enter the civilian market. After shaking, the tip emits crackling sounds and flashes. It has caused several terrible accidents leading to its discontinuation.
equip_des_11800251: 学会一些较为危险的实验室里常用到的防护材料，材质轻便结实。有几率在关键时刻抵挡来自外部的伤害。
equip_des_11800252: Used by scholars to stimulate the brain to maintain focus, but it has some side effects and should be used with caution.
equip_des_11800253: One of the many weapons created by the Destroyer, it appears as simple and effective as magic to those unfamiliar with its principles. By simply lifting the box accompanied by a dazzling light, it can effortlessly crush concrete walls and pierce through armor plates. However, the intense light is unnecessary in its principle, designed only to increase deterrence.
equip_des_11800254: Used to dissect Chaos Remains, capable of tearing apart most synthetic materials or cutting through the skin and scales of large Chaos Remains.
equip_des_11800255: This armor material, created by the Destroyer, has excellent protective properties and can absorb energy to accelerate cellular healing.
equip_des_11800256: Capable of extracting information from the environment and efficiently transmitting it to the user, it can help the user speed up intelligence processing during combat.
equip_des_11800257: A weapon of unknown principles that transcends causality, no one can predict the outcome it will lead the user to.
equip_des_11800258: Weapon carried by mysterious entities patrolling the Fabricate. Humans know little about this entity and the origin of this weapon.
equip_des_11800259: This material is merely a projection of a high-dimensional object into three-dimensional space, allowing it to change its structure like programming, making it an almost universal substance.
equip_des_11800260: Used to analyze the internal structure of targets from higher dimensions and change functions rapidly.
equip_des_11800261: An ancient weapon of unknown origin acquired by the Citadel from the chaos space. It emits gravitons and possesses destructive power akin to the fusion of black holes. Through modifications made by the Citadel, it can be easily wielded by humans. Theoretically, if the Citadel were to create a more potent version, it could potentially even obliterate Morphic Moon.\n [This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800262: Capable of interfering with timelines, nicknamed the "Regret Potion," it offers the user an extra chance to make a choice from an alternate timeline, but the user must pay a corresponding price.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800263: In countless timelines, there is always a future where "you are alive". Wearing an armor made of this fabric, you can ensure you reach that safe node unscathed.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800264: The portable version of Haima Zaria, capable of freely changing the rules of reality around.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800265: Weapon commonly used by Empire soldiers.
equip_des_11800266: Armor commonly used by Empire soldiers.
equip_des_11800267: Emblem with a cute cat pattern. Attached with magical abilities, it can extend the duration of some special transformation spells, albeit with weak energy. Perhaps it was created by an Empire mage on a whim.
equip_des_11800268: Wand reverse-engineered from the magical echoes of the second wish made by the ancestors of the Mundus Empire at the Wishing Tower. It is said that the sun emerged from the top of the Wishing Tower by this wish, and this wand can also produce intense flashes capable of blinding and burning.
equip_des_11800269: Dagger crafted by underground mages seeking stars in the absence of the starry sky, based on the second wish made by the Empire's ancestors at the Wishing Tower. This wish brought life to the Mundus Garden. The dagger shines with the gentle light of distant stars and can heal the wounds of the wearer.
equip_des_11800270: True starlight from the chaos world — those twinkling sparks.
equip_des_11800271: Emblem engraved with a lion pattern, a testament to the bravery of warriors.
equip_des_11800272: Result of the conflict between the two schools of the Empire Magic Academy, where one believes that Strange Sparks are the most powerful magic. If used by a talented individual capable of unleashing Strange Sparks, it can unleash even greater power.
equip_des_11800273: Result of the conflict between the two schools of the Empire Magic Academy, where one believes that Shadowcraft is the pinnacle of magic. If used by a talented individual capable of unleashing Shadowcraft, it can unleash even greater power.
equip_des_11800274: Harnessing the vitality brought by the Wishing Tower into the armor.
equip_des_11800275: Material extracted from the artificial sun atop the Wishing Tower.
equip_des_11800276: If outer space is infinitly large, then large things can also become infinitely small. This concept is applied to create a staff, which compresses magic that would normally require a large volume into a very small one. It serves as a much more powerful mana container than the human body. The user can easily unleash extremely powerful magic.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800278: The magical echoes of the dawn's wishing directly infused into the material of the armor, giving it the ability to restore vitality. Since this material has only been manufactured once in history, it is extremely rare.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800279: A ring of unknown origin, said to have belonged to the missing King of the Empire and inscribed with a covenant made with Arthu Jin. It is said to summon powerful servants.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800280: A conveniently concealable sharp blade that is difficult to detect by conventional scans, the preferred choice for clandestine operations.
equip_des_11800281: Equipment designed for special missions to blend in civilians, featuring unique, stylish lines that exude elegance and carefully selected materials that hint at understated luxury. Oh, and it's bulletproof too.
equip_des_11800282: Smoke grenade commonly used by Night Chains operatives, capable of helping the user move in and out like a ninja, and more importantly, it looks cool, adopting the same design philosophy as the Spring Fashion Show this year, embodying the designer's... For more, see Issue 208 of "Night Chains Fashion Trends."
equip_des_11800283: A compact and foldable sniper rifle, not only powerful but also impeccably designed. Its exquisite and elegant design makes it versatile without losing its sophistication. The designer's pursuit of stylish aesthetics is evident in every detail.
equip_des_11800284: A cane sword used by elite Night Chains operatives, it won fourth place in the annual favorite items awards within Night Chains. Its sleek and understated design makes it irresistible, and its lightweight nature allows the user to wield it with ease and style in combat. While its sharpness is unquestionable, that's not what draws most people's attention.
equip_des_11800285: A special equipment used by Night Chains executors, capable of temporarily rendering oneself invisible in critical situations.
equip_des_11800286: Autonomous drones developed by Night Chains, featuring long endurance, capable of automatically sniping enemies on the battlefield.
equip_des_11800288: A dagger perfect for stealthy operations, when combined with the smoke grenades commonly used by Night Chains, the last thing the enemy sees is a flash of cold light. Some may expect to hear more praises about it, but not everyone appreciates that kind of exaggerated rhetoric.
equip_des_11800289: Power mecha material assisted in combat by AI, with each pattern on the armor plates handcrafted by artisans, meticulously drawn stroke by stroke, showcasing elegance from the details. It provides all-around protection for the wearer, with AI taking over actions when necessary, ensuring that even in situations of unconsciousness, the wearer can continue to fight and maintain a regal demeanor.
equip_des_11800290: A subprogram of the Night Chains super AI, capable of predicting the outcomes of events in advance and providing contingency plans, allowing the user to better cope with upcoming combats.
equip_Getway_11800291_0_DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop
equip_des_11800291: Highly automated, freeing you from tedious operations and allowing you to act stealthily. The Invisible function ensures covert operations, helping you to take enemies by surprise. With a 20-meter effective range, it captures everything you want to seize. Tenryu Rangetsu Chain, a thoughtful chain dart, binds enemies and seizes the moment.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800292: A short sword with teleportation technology, allowing the user's movements to be as swift as lightning. In this high-speed state, the time dilation caused by the theory of relativity greatly enhances the user's reaction speed.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800293: Energy armor designed by a super AI. Selected faux wood materials create a calm and elegant charm, with natural style patterns adding texture. When activated, it emits swirling smoke, creating a serene and distant atmosphere. It can conceal the wearer's form and withstand attacks when traveling, and decorate the space when at home.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800294: The highest authorized symbol of Night Chains, even in offline mode, this device can run 80% of the functions of the super AI, providing users with absolutely correct advice and greatly enhancing intelligence processing and decision-making capabilities.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800295: Space transfer equipment developed by Anita, capable of temporarily phasing the wearer into the phase space to evade attacks. However, it requires the wearer to use skills to reach the special morphic field values needed for the function.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800296: A personnel recovery device, also used flexibly by some for movement on the battlefield.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800297: Sometimes, the Citadel accelerates the time of certain objects, and inexplicably, at the end of this process, the mass of these objects mysteriously increases. Scholars have found a practical use for these materials: knocking people unconscious.
equip_des_11800298: Limbs of a creature from a certain dream realm, somehow brought into reality.
equip_des_11800299: A magic bow with seven strings, said to shoot arrows that can harm not only the body but also the soul of a person.
equip_des_11800300: A weapon used by a swordsmaster of the former Northern Alliance, which releases threads to entangle opponents during combat.
equip_des_11800301: Holding this weapon makes the wielder more aggressive in combat, inflicting more damage on enemies.
equip_des_11800302: Holding this weapon intensifies the damage of lightning against enemies, akin to a deity in stories who can control lightning.
equip_des_11800303: Holding this weapon intensifies the damage of fire against enemies, resembling a volcano erupting.
equip_des_11800304: A portable anti-gravity flight device invented by a civilian scientist, which can indeed reduce weight.
equip_des_11800305: When placed on head, it can receive the power of teleportation from Dracanaru.
equip_des_11800306: A hat that can shield against psychic control-related ascension abilities.
equip_des_11800307: Upon detecting the wearer losing consciousness, it automatically activates the acupoint pressure function, restoring consciousness.
equip_des_11800308: It can emit a ray that only those who believe in its existence can see, causing the loss of combat will. The more the user believes in its existence, the stronger its effect.
equip_des_11800309: A camera that can capture images of morphic field, helping the holder anticipate potential resonance effects.
equip_des_11800310: Mounting a gun on a treasure-seeking rod — wouldn't it be able to both discover treasures and automatically lock onto enemies?\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800311: People who listen to this song will fall into a state of frenzy, becoming extremely excited and more aggressive. Sometimes, there may even be more severe consequences.
equip_des_11800312: A metal not native to Earth. Originally rare, but after Morphic Moon incident, non-Earth materials are everywhere, and this metal has become commonplace.
equip_des_11800313: If you fail to hypnotize someone using the swing of a pocket watch, perhaps it's because you're using the wrong pocket watch — why not try this one?
equip_des_11800314: It will spring forth arcane energy like a fountain, providing energy replenishment to the wearer.
equip_des_11800316: A weapon designed for summoning lightning. It faced operational challenges due to magnetic issues with a crucial component. However, a powerful Ascender can alter its magnetic properties, thereby enabling it to actually summon lightning.\n [This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800002: Unlike the faction that pursues Shadowcraft and Strange Spark, the creator of this weapon believes in empowering ordinary individuals with magical abilities. Even in the hands of a commoner, this weapon possesses devastating power.
equip_des_11800001: This life form captured in the labyrinth by the scholars of the Citadel. All things undergo a constant cycle of birth and death, and through this eye, one can catch a glimpse of the mysteries of existence.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800003: When placed in complete darkness, it summons an ancient power that not even the Citadel can fully comprehend, which often results in catastrophic consequences.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800006: This device is an adaptation derived from an enigmatic technological creation discovered in the chaos world. Due to limitations in Anita's technology, it is unable to operate at its fullest capacity, and its energy can only incrementally increase over time. It is estimated that after 34 years of uninterrupted operation, it will emit enough rays to potentially destroy the world, although this is still far from reaching its limit.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800007: An ancient artifact from the mysterious east, collected by Night Chains. Its remarkable ability to cut through anything and its unique preservation methods have garnered widespread belief among the Empire citizens that it possesses the power of magic. However, the origins and principles underlying its magic differ from those of Mundus, and the true secret may only be known to Night Chains.\n [This equipment is unique.]
