equip_des_11800008: This weapon, developed by the Earth Union, harnesses evidently hazardous technology. Its power is so formidable that even the Citadel refrains from recovering it. The mere presence of this weapon hinders the Earth Union's Jupiter exploration project.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800009: This weapon is a rare creation of the Citadel with a singular purpose of destruction. It does not incorporate high-dimensional, timeline, or morphic resonance technology. As long as the temperature is high enough, there is nothing that it cannot melt.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800011: Confiscated marauder armor coated in cactus juice. It is widely believed by marauders that cactus works wonders in combating morphic field pollution and can also be used for healing.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800013: Confiscated from Jude, this launcher was not originally designed to be fowl-friendly and later adopted a structure that could be hung from a goose. While humans can use it too, its efficiency depends on the user's posture.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800012: A talisman that helps people relax and calm their nerves. It was once attached to a computer, enhancing its RAM operation efficiency.
equip_des_11800015: A charm that harnesses a mysterious energy called "celestial thunder." While primarily used for combat, it can also recharge electronic devices.
equip_des_11800016: Automatically deployed in battle, this drone uses Trigram Mirror to create favorable Fengshui effects on the battlefield.
equip_Getway_11800017_0_DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop
equip_des_11800017: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.
equip_des_11800018: A formation formed by eight drones, its power strong enough to subdue large Chaos Remains with ease.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_Getway_11800019_0_DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop
equip_des_11800019: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.
equip_des_11800021: The magical echoes of the dawn's wishing directly infused into the material of the armor, giving it the ability to restore vitality. Since this material has only been manufactured once in history, it is extremely rare.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800022: A tool invented by a talented prisoner at Yunxiu Bridge, enabling the creation of two interconnecting portals on walls. However, since the exit was too high above ground level, his escape attempt resulted in severe injury, and his tool was damaged. As a result, the exit portal has been permanently fixed in his cell.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800029: A device designed by the Citadel to delve into Unbewusstes and explore mankind's deep subconscious. When activated, it causes mental interference.
equip_des_11800031: A time-keeper imitating a pulsar, boasting precision surpassing an atomic clock. It emits light-speed pulses at a frequency of a thousand revolutions per second, capable of releasing powerful pulses in a fixed direction after being constrained by the restraint device.
equip_des_11800033: Able to transit the wearer to a non-probabilistic state, entangling atoms within the armor with particles in random corners of the universe, thus deflecting incoming attacks.
equip_des_11800040: Summon a projection of wearer's grandfather in his youth to take the attack on the wearer's behalf. However, due to the grandfather paradox, the attack will be excluded from the world line.\n[This gear is unique.]
equip_des_11800041: This equipment seems like an exaggerated electromagnet from animated shows. It is believed to have the ability to propel large vehicles by attaching it to the front of vehicles, generating endless power. Due to its excessive strength, it was deemed hazardous and confiscated by Base Yunxiu Bridge.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_Getway_11800042_0_DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop
equip_des_11800042: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.
equip_des_11800049: Armor designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants. No doubt it incorporates the technology that the Empire call "magic", but its underlying principles diverge from the mainstream methods prevalent in the Empire.
equip_des_11800050: An ancient artifact from Night Chains' collection. No magic traces or morphic field anomalies are detected on it, making it seem like an ordinary handicraft, but it revealed miraculous powers when its owners face mortal peril, guiding them to safety in miraculous ways. Following such interventions, the magatama always broke unexpectedly, and it was always repaired as a normal handicraft.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800051: Lying shall be punished by lightning strikes, so it can increase the rate of Electrify.
equip_des_11800052: Weapon carried by mysterious entities patrolling the Fabricate. Humans know little about this entity and the origin of this weapon.
equip_des_11800054: A technological relic from the Golden Age of the Earth Union, providing maximum protection. BCRL can no longer produce such advanced armor.
equip_des_11800056: A headband worn by Night Chains defectors, featuring a defaced Night Chains symbol symbolizing their resolve for rebellion. In the case of a potent Ascender wearing it, their unwavering determination can imprint the headband, resulting in enigmatic protective properties.
equip_des_11800058: Made from special materials developed by the Empire for resisting arcane energies.
equip_des_11800059: For the sages of the Citadel, knowledge is life. Thus, safeguarding knowledge is akin to safeguarding life itself. They developed such devices to store their memories and wisdom externally, ensuring that even in the event of fatal bodily harm, their lives would endure beyond their physical existence.
equip_des_11800060: A peculiar non-crystalline fossil with a galaxy contained within. Microscopic observation reveals the orbit of its stellar system.\n[This equipment is unique.]
equip_des_11800061: Earth Union scientists propose that the light emanating from the Wishing Tower originates not from the sun, but from a B-type star. Imperial scholars offer a more nuanced perspective, suggesting the presence of a companion star, and they have even harnessed this celestial power to create a magical staff.
equip_des_11800062: A weapon designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants, developed using a similar "magic" technology as the ancient artifact "Kusa Ryujaku." No one knows if Night Chains rediscovered this tech from the artifact, or the skill of crafting such a weapon was never truly lost.
equip_des_11800063: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, if not supplied with a large amount of energy to sustain it, it will continuously absorb heat from the environment until it melts itself.
equip_des_11800064: A device originally designed for cooling the Reality Stabilizer during emergencies, later repurposed by security personnel to quell riots. This device has the ability to make metals brittle, proving effective against non-military armor in combat situations.
equip_des_11800065: This device was crafted by a Citadel sage known as "Nictar" before his passing. Although believed to hold the key to the ultimate mystery of the universe, it has never exhibited any known function besides eradicating all life within its range.
equip_des_11800066: Anita researchers studying ball lightning have discovered that it is actually not a standard electrical discharge but rather connected to the collapse of wave functions of elementary particles. This mysterious force can disrupt the structure of matter in an unpredictable manner, even at the particle level. Following the development of this prototype, the Citadel discovered their risky research and confiscated the prototype.
equip_des_11800020: Armor crafted from the bones of Bone Dragons hunted in the heavily polluted regions. It not only provides protection against Chaos Remains but also deters outlaws.
equip_des_11800067: Discovered by a Citadel scholar during his study of acoustics, this phenomenon demonstrates how vibrational frequency influences standing wave patterns on vibrating surfaces. A similar observation was later noted in research on morphic resonance. This device adjusts the user's morphic field to optimize its impact on the target.
equip_des_11800027: A retrieval device for the Fabricate, salvaged by the sages of the Citadel, featuring a central tablet believed to embody the will of the Maze itself.
equip_des_11800068: Exoskeletons designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants. These devices significantly enhance the wearer's defense and strength. While this may appear contradictory to Night Chains' typical secretive nature, even they must confront formidable foes directly on occasion.
equip_des_11800078: Upon first entering Mundus, the Empire experienced plague, famine, war, and severe cold. Later, the people of the Empire overcame these four disasters and crafted this amulet, symbolizing the sealing of these four calamities. Although the Empire did not rely solely on magic to overcome these disasters, the significance represented by the amulet still endows it with special magical power.
equip_des_11800079: A wand containing a mysterious creature's feather, possesses great power. It is said that there is another wand in the world made with the same feather; that one is male, and yours is female. When the two wands meet, they will lose their power.\n[This gear is unique.]
equip_des_11800080: A crystal stone with magical powers, it is said that the holder can drain a continuous stream of power from it, and thus it has been mistakenly rumored to possess healing and even resurrection abilities.\n[This gear is unique.]
equip_des_11800081: Multipurpose familiar armor, providing comprehensive protection for familiars of different sizes and shapes. Small ones can hide inside, large ones can wear it outside!
equip_des_11800084: A civilian product once produced by Source Citadel, a table knife that polishes itself. Its molecules have immense horizontal binding force, thus slowly moving its vertical molecules to the horizontal direction to keep the surface polished. Meanwhile this process makes the blade increasingly sharp until reaching a unimolecular state. Production was discontinued after several accidents.
equip_des_11800089: A spell blade in flame, also the totem representing justice for the Empire. Legend has it that its flame only burns the souls of the wicked.
equip_des_11800090: Attached the wind to the surface of the armor, the high-speed flowing air can deflect the direction of attacks.
equip_des_11800091: This extraordinary drill is the extension of Mechanical Vatican's sacred will. When it starts to roar, it is the death knell for heresy - rending falsehoods, penetrating resistance with unstoppable spiral force, and executing the unquestionable divine judgment. Earthly barriers are like thin paper before it. The judgment is set, only the spiral remains eternal.\n[This gear is unique.]
equip_des_11800092: Made in private by an Anita researcher. Causes sickness after consuming, but increases the user's resistance against Reverengy.
equip_des_11800093: A light, a life incarnate. Its crafting method is considered the ultimate taboo. All related information, including its creator, is now sealed in the deepest of the Fabricate.
equip_des_11800094: A device used for imbuing knowledge to human brain through heavy smash, though always results in tragedies. Few people can endure both the physical impact from the device and the mental impact from the influx of knowledge. Now used by Source Citadel as a mere weapon.
equip_des_11800095: Wearing it means to accept the fate of a Tower Knight, along with its burden.
equip_Getway_11800097_0_DisplayName: 曙光号爆破事件兑换商店
equip_des_11800097: 铁盟的机密研发项目成果，采用了某种地联时期尚未完善、但如今已得到控制的技术，仅供个体能力优秀的士兵使用。
tws_text_85100036: Impact Force when breaking through obstacles +%s.
tws_text_85100224: You have a %s%% chance to obtain loots after a successful Ram Disengage.
hw_des_83100010: The most common anti-collision device. Capable of knocking away most debris.
tws_text_85100238: [Interrupt] all enemies at the beginning of each combat that occurs during driving.
hw_des_83100012: Headlights that even train robbers fear.
tws_text_85100001: Chance of encountering an ambush while traveling increased by %s%%.
tws_text_85100243: Reduces all enemies' DEF by %s%% at the beginning of each combat that occurs during driving.
hw_des_83100013: Causes people who hear it to be on edge. Might attract enemies.
hw_des_83100014: A coating made of cactus juice. The Marauders have a superstition that cacti can dispel Morphic Field Pollution, which has been proven effective to some extent.
